title: Still Life & Flowers
description: Quiet arrangements of fruit, flowers, and objects — beauty in the everyday.
source: Art Institute of Chicago, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Still Life with Flowers
items.description_narrative: A loose bouquet of poppies, anemones, and wildflowers rises from a simple brown vase into a haze of indistinct color, more atmosphere than background. Butterflies drift among the blooms as if the flowers themselves were dissolving into color and light.
items.tags: still life, flowers, oil on canvas, symbolism, butterflies, redon, dreamlike

items.title: Still Life with Flowers
items.description_narrative: A dense bouquet of white, purple, pink, and orange blossoms overflows a dark vessel set on a wooden tabletop, spilling loose stems and petals beyond its rim. Henri Fantin-Latour painted this still life in oil in 1881; it belongs to the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: still life, flowers, oil painting, 19th century, french art, realism

items.title: Trompe-l'Oeil Still Life with a Flower Garland and a Curtain
items.agent_name: Adriaen van der Spelt and Frans van Mieris the Elder
items.description_narrative: A shimmering blue silk curtain, hung from a real-looking brass rod, appears to have been drawn back to reveal a bouquet of roses, tulips, and poppies painted below. The trick is the whole point: the curtain and its rings are as carefully rendered as the flowers they seem to protect.
items.tags: still life, oil on panel, trompe l'oeil, flowers, dutch golden age, curtain

items.title: Magnolias on Light Blue Velvet Cloth
items.description_narrative: Three magnolia blossoms lie fully open on a dark velvet cloth, their waxy white petals rendered with almost photographic precision against glossy green leaves, some already curling brown at the edges. A single closed bud waits beside them, the whole arrangement lit as if under glass.
items.tags: still life, magnolia, flowers, oil on canvas, velvet, botanical realism

items.title: For Sunday's Dinner
items.description_narrative: A plucked chicken hangs upside down by its bound feet against a dark wooden door, its skin catching the light while a few stray feathers still cling to the surface. Painted brass hinges and a keyhole plate complete the deception, the whole scene rendered so precisely it seems to project off the canvas.
items.tags: still life, trompe l'oeil, oil on canvas, plucked chicken, wood door, american realism

items.title: Still Life with Dead Game, Fruits, and Vegetables in a Market
items.description_narrative: A gray-bearded vendor in a red coat doffs his hat over a market stall piled almost past reading: a hanging deer carcass, a swan with wings spread wide, a peacock, rabbits, and a boar's head jostle against baskets of fruit and heads of cauliflower and leek, while a boy peers up from the crowd below.
items.tags: still life, game market, oil on canvas, flemish baroque, deer, swan, vendor

items.title: Just Dessert
items.description_narrative: A cluster of green grapes spills off a marble ledge, draped between a copper pail, a rope-wrapped blue jar, and a pewter tankard. A halved coconut and a small wooden crate stamped "Smyrna" hint at goods carried a long way, while a leafy branch rises between the vessels like an afterthought of green.
items.tags: still life, oil on canvas, tabletop arrangement, grapes, copper pail, coconut

items.title: Still Life with Monkey, Fruits, and Flowers
items.description_narrative: A monkey leans over a stone balustrade, tail curled high, and reaches its long arm down to pilfer grapes from a silver basket of fruit below. Pink hollyhocks climb a garden wall on one side, an urn of flowers sits on the ledge, and a split melon and peaches spill across the foreground.
items.tags: still life, monkey, oil on canvas, rococo, fruit, garden setting, flowers

items.title: Still Life
items.description_narrative: A pie sits cut open on a black plate, its dark filling exposed next to curls of sliced lemon peel. A tall, ornate wine glass and a large pewter pitcher anchor the table, while bread, nuts, and olives spread across a white cloth trimmed with lace at one corner.
items.tags: still life, oil on panel, dutch golden age, banquet piece, pewter pitcher, pie

items.title: Thistles
items.description_narrative: Dried, pale thistle stalks tangle across a rust-red ground in quick, sketch-like strokes, more impression than inventory of any single plant. The loose, almost calligraphic brushwork turns a patch of dead weeds into a study of texture and light.
items.tags: still life, oil on canvas, thistles, loose brushwork, impressionism, botanical study

items.title: Roses in a Bowl
items.description_narrative: Cream and pink roses cluster in a dark bowl that all but disappears into the deep brown background, so that the blooms seem to float in shadow. A separate white rose lies loose on the table in the foreground, its stem and leaves catching a little more light than the bouquet above.
items.tags: still life, roses, flowers, oil on canvas, dark background, bouquet

items.title: Wine, Cheese, and Fruit
items.description_narrative: Six glasses of wine, poured to different levels, crowd a table already loaded with two bottles, a white pitcher, cheese and crackers, and a raised dish of wafers. A porcelain bowl heaped with grapes, apples, oranges, and cracked walnuts spills its shells across the cloth on the right.
items.tags: still life, oil on canvas, wine glasses, fruit, cheese, american art, tabletop

items.title: Lights of Other Days
items.description_narrative: A cluttered wooden shelf holds a jumble of obsolete lighting: a battered oil lantern, brass candlesticks still fitted with stubs of candle, a glass dome, and a tin lamp with its door hanging open. A dented cup dangles precariously off the shelf's edge, as if the whole collection were about to spill into the dark room below.
items.tags: still life, oil on canvas, lanterns, candlesticks, clutter, american realism, dim interior

items.title: Basket of Fruit (Canestra di Frutta)
items.description_narrative: A woven basket teeters at the very edge of a table, set against nothing but bare, golden wall. Look closely and the fruit is not perfect: an apple carries a worm hole, and the vine leaves curl and brown at their tips, a quietly honest note of decay amid the grapes, figs, and peaches.
items.tags: still life, fruit basket, oil on canvas, baroque, botanical detail, wicker basket

items.title: Still Life with Flowers in a Wan-Li Vase
items.description_narrative: A striped, flame-patterned tulip crowns a tight bouquet packed into a blue-and-white porcelain vase painted with leaves and blossoms of its own. Roses, a marigold, white narcissus, and a small brown butterfly perched at the edge fill in the rest, each flower rendered with the same crisp, individual attention.
items.tags: still life, flowers, oil on copper, tulip, dutch golden age, porcelain vase, butterfly

items.title: Vase of Flowers
items.description_narrative: An orange crown imperial towers over a lavish bouquet packed into a terracotta urn carved with a classical relief. Roses, striped tulips, and poppies cascade down toward a bird's nest with three small eggs tucked at the base, while a butterfly hovers at the upper left of the arrangement.
items.tags: still life, flowers, oil on panel, dutch golden age, van huysum, bird's nest, butterfly

items.title: Still Life with Lobster
items.description_narrative: A bright red lobster stands out sharply against the near-black background, its claws draped over the edge of a silver platter. Behind it a silver-mounted drinking horn and a pair of glasses catch what little light there is, while a richly patterned cloth and a spiral of lemon peel soften the display's cold formality.
items.tags: still life, oil on canvas, dutch golden age, pronkstilleven, lobster, drinking horn

items.title: Banquet Piece with Mince Pie
items.cultural_context: Dutch Golden Age still life, Haarlem
items.description_narrative: A pewter jug, a tall gilt covered cup, and a squat silver salt cellar with its lid propped open stand among pewter plates on a linen-draped table, beside a peeled lemon and an unlit candle. Painted by Willem Claesz. Heda in 1635, this Dutch Golden Age still life favors muted browns, silvers, and golds.
items.tags: still life, dutch golden age, heda, pewter, salt cellar, gilt cup, vanitas

items.title: Still Life with Flowers on a Marble Tabletop
items.cultural_context: Dutch Golden Age flower painting, Amsterdam
items.description_narrative: White and pink roses tumble over the edge of a marble tabletop while an iris and orange poppies rise above a dense mass of greenery. Life keeps intruding on the arrangement: a small white butterfly clings to a leaf, a caterpillar inches across the stone, and a single wheat stalk crosses the bouquet's base.
items.tags: still life, flowers, oil on canvas, dutch golden age, rachel ruysch, insects, roses

items.title: The Ray
items.description_narrative: A gutted ray hangs from a hook at the top of the composition, its pale underside turned outward so that its odd, almost face-like markings stare down at the table below. A dead chicken dangles off the table's edge, its head hanging past the stone ledge, while a copper pot, a jug, eggs, and green onions fill out a scene of ordinary kitchen goods.
items.tags: still life, oil on canvas, chardin, fish, kitchen scene, copper pot

items.title: Still Life with Cheeses, Almonds and Pretzels
items.description_narrative: Two wedges of cheese lean against each other, one pale and crumbling, one dark-rinded, with a wedge already cut and stacked on top. A stoneware jug with a hinged lid and a stemmed glass of wine flank the cheese, while a coiled pretzel and a blue-and-white dish of almonds and dried fruit fill the foreground.
items.tags: still life, oil on panel, flemish baroque, cheese, pretzel, stoneware jug

items.title: Still Life with Fruit, Fish, and a Nest
items.description_narrative: A basket overflows with grapes, peaches, plums, and melon beneath a tree where finches perch and a bird's nest cradles a clutch of eggs in the foliage. Strung fish hang at the right while a frog and a small lizard explore the forest floor below.
items.tags: still life, oil on canvas, dutch golden age, birds, fish, forest floor, fruit basket

items.title: Fruit Still Life with Shells and Tulip
items.cultural_context: Dutch Golden Age still life, Utrecht
items.description_narrative: A blue-and-white porcelain plate piled with citrons, grapes, and peaches sits on a rust-orange cloth scattered with seashells and a single white tulip. A dragonfly perches on the fruit and a butterfly rests near the flower, small living details that animate the quiet arrangement.
items.tags: still life, fruit, seashells, tulip, oil on panel, dutch golden age, insects

items.title: Fish (Still Life)
items.description_narrative: A large silvery fish curls across a white cloth, its tail flicked skyward, next to a small red fish, a coiled eel, and a heap of oysters. A gleaming copper pot and a bright lemon with a knife balance the cool grays and pinks of the catch with warm, reflective color.
items.tags: still life, fish, oysters, oil on canvas, kitchen scene, copper pot

items.title: Still Life with Fruit and Wine Jug
items.cultural_context: Precursor to Post-Impressionism, influence on van Gogh
items.description_narrative: Pears and an apple sit on a plate beside a white ceramic jug, the paint laid on so thickly it reads almost as relief. A richly patterned cloth, its reds and greens blurred into loose dabs, covers the table and dominates the composition as much as the fruit itself.
items.tags: still life, oil on panel, fruit, impasto, patterned cloth, jug

items.title: Calf's Head and Ox Tongue
items.description_narrative: A skinned calf's head and a raw ox tongue hang side by side from butcher's hooks, painted with loose, vigorous strokes that turn pale flesh and torn red muscle into passages of pure color. A chain looped below the rail is the only other prop, the scene as blunt and unglamorous as any Parisian market stall.
items.tags: still life, butcher shop, oil on canvas, impressionism, meat, loose brushwork
